#+title: Emphasis *in* a /keyword/ value stays text

* Plain *bold* /italic/ _under_ +strike+ =verb= ~code~ in a title :tag:
* A title ending in *bold*
* *bold at the start* of a title
* COMMENT *bold* after a comment keyword

Simple: *bold* /italic/ _underline_ +strike+ =verbatim= ~code~.
Nested: *bold /italic _under +strike =v= ~c~ +_/* and /a *b* c/.
Pre chars: (*a*) '*b*' "*c*" {*d*} -*e*- x*f*y and a*b* and *g*x.
Post chars: *a*. *b*, *c*; *d*: *e*! *f*? *g*' *h*" *i*) *j*} *k*\ *l*[ *m*-
Spaces: * not bold* *not bold * *  * ** *a* ** *a *b* c*
Across lines: *one
two* and /three

four/ (blank line splits the paragraph).
Markup inside verbatim: =*not bold* [[not a link]]= ~$x$ \alpha~ =a=b= ~a~b~.
Post blank: *a*   then *b*	then =c=  	end.
Unclosed: *never closed /also never _nor this +or this =or= ~this
Mark at region end: *a* *b
*x*
Single chars: *a* /b/ _c_ +d+ =e= ~f~ and *** and =/= and /=/.
Unicode: *émphase* /日本語/ _ü_ *a* * b* *ß*.
Underline vs subscript: a_b_c x_{i}_ _a_b_ __a__ (_a_) -_b_ {_c_}.

- *bold* item :: with /italic/ in the description
- term *x* :: definition *y*
- =verb= :: tag ending in verbatim
- =verb=  :: two blanks before the separator
- *b*		:: tabs before the separator
- [ ] *checkbox then bold*

| *bold* | /it/ | _u_ | +s+ | =v= | ~c~ |
| *a | b* | =c | d= |
